Bag End Dining RoomThe Hobbit: An Unexpected JourneyThirteen dwarves. One pantry.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersCheddar, pork pie and pickle boardAged cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, apple and crusty breadHow to make it300g aged cheddar2 pork pies200g pickled onions3 green apples1 crusty loafCut the cheddar into wedges and slice the pork pies.Cut the apples into wedges and tear the crusty loaf.Pile everything onto a big board with the pickled onions so guests can raid it at once.Green salad with mint and pepitasSalad leaves, pea shoots, cucumber and mint with a lemon dressingHow to make it150g mixed salad leaves1 punnet pea shoots1 Lebanese cucumber, thinly sliced1/4 cup mint leaves, torn1 lemon3 tbsp olive oil50g pepitasToast the pepitas in a dry pan.Slice the cucumber and tear the mint.Toss the leaves, pea shoots, cucumber and mint, then dress with lemon juice and olive oil.Scatter with pepitas and pile lightly onto a pale platter.Gollum's crispy flathead with tartareRiddles in the dark and a precious ringHow to make itAs written, serves 4Flathead pieces dusted in seasoned flour, fried in hot oil until crisp, served with tartare sauce and lemon wedges.Cut 600g flathead fillets into fingers and pat dry.Season 100g plain flour with salt, pepper and a pinch of paprika.Dust the fish in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then coat in 120g panko crumbs.Shallow fry in 1cm of oil at 180°C for 2 minutes a side until golden.Mix 150g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped gherkin, chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon.Serve the fish with the tartare and lemon wedges.MainsSausage, bacon and eggs breakfastPork sausages, bacon, mushrooms, tomatoes and fried eggsHow to make it8 thick pork sausages8 rashers of bacon200g mushrooms, sliced4 tomatoes, halved4 eggs8 slices of white bread40g butterFry the sausages until browned.Add the bacon, mushrooms and tomatoes to the pan.Fry the eggs in the fat at the end.Toast the bread and butter it.Plate it all up.Trolls' garlic and rosemary roast lambThe three trolls roasting mutton over the fireHow to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb leg rubbed with garlic, rosemary and salt, roasted at 180°C for 90 minutes, with roast potatoes and carrots.Cut small slits all over a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and small rosemary sprigs.Rub with olive oil and plenty of salt and pepper.Roast at 180°C for 90 minutes for medium, adding 1kg potatoes in chunks and 4 carrots tossed in oil to the tray for the last hour.Rest the lamb 15 minutes under foil.Carve thick and serve with the roast veg, pan juices and mint sauce.SweetsBilbo's seed cakeButter loaf cake with caraway seedsHow to make it175g butter, softened175g caster sugar3 eggs225g self-raising flour2 tsp caraway seeds2 tbsp milkBeat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs.Fold in the flour, caraway seeds and milk.Pour into a lined loaf tin.Bake at 170°C.Cool the cake.Slice to serve with a cup of tea.DrinksDwarvish spiced apple punchWarm apple juice and black tea with honey, cinnamon, cloves and orange, topped with ginger beerHow to make it750ml cloudy apple juice3 tbsp honey6 cinnamon sticks4 cloves1 orange1 black tea bag750ml ginger beerPeel strips of zest from the orange.Simmer the apple juice with the honey, 2 cinnamon sticks, cloves and zest, then add the tea bag for 3 minutes and lift it out.Turn the heat to low and add the ginger beer, warming through without boiling.Ladle into mugs and add a cinnamon stick to each.Chamomile tea with honeyDori's offer to Gandalf, a small cup.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
